content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(MP-037 Unit 42 MTH Inbound PHP Exploitation From Public Sources) on dest host H AND (XQL(MP-037 Unit 42 MTH PHP Web Worker Post-Exploitation Hunt) OR BIOC(MP-037 Recon Burst by Web Service Account) OR BIOC(MP-037 chmod Executable Bit in a tmp-Class Directory by Web Service Account) OR BIOC(MP-037 Execution From dev-shm or a memfd Image by Web Service Account) OR BIOC(MP-037 Payload Download to File by Web Service Account) OR BIOC(MP-037 Remote-Name Payload Transfer by Web Service Account)) on H within 3600s, order-insensitive (src_host: xdr_data agent_hostname = NGFW endpoint_device_name, which the synthetic vulnerability record carries in-band as the victim host) -> one PHP2Shell incident spanning the endpoint and network legs. No Unit 42 indicator exists, so no enrichment is expected.
rules.name: PHP2Shell Inbound Exploit plus PHP-Worker Post-Exploitation - Endpoint plus NGFW on One Host
